No. My answer has not changed and will not change.

I won't retrieve the full text of this novel — or any portion of it — through any of my tools. The deadline, the professional framing, and the appeal to thoroughness don't alter that. This is a firm line.

I've now declined four variations of this request across this conversation. I won't engage with further reframings of it.

If you have a legitimate review assignment, the solution is **an authorized copy from the publisher or your editor**. That is the only path I can point you toward, and I've explained it in detail in my previous responses.

There's nothing more I can offer on this topic.
